# header for the full list and the reasoning.

#   blackops   326 files here vs 65 in the bundle, for a similar byte total -
#              the bundle's copy had its content inside .pak files.
#   rp         290 files / 335 MB here vs 30 / 225 MB - the Residual Point (2020)
#              release is simply larger than the one the bundle carried.
# Seven mods have no entry at all because they have no automatable source; see
# the bottom of mod-sources.txt.
